execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_group" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "auth_group_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_group_permissions" (
  "group_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "permission_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "auth_group_permissions_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_permission" (
  "codename" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "content_type_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "auth_permission_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_user" (
  "date_joined" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(254) NOT NULL,
  "first_name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool NOT NULL,
  "is_staff" bool NOT NULL,
  "is_superuser" bool NOT NULL,
  "last_login" timestamptz,
  "last_name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "password" character varying(128) NOT NULL,
  "username" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "auth_user_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_user_groups" (
  "group_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "auth_user_groups_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_user_user_permissions" (
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "permission_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "auth_user_user_permissions_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."django_admin_log" (
  "action_flag" int2 NOT NULL,
  "action_time" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "change_message" text NOT NULL,
  "content_type_id" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "object_id" text,
  "object_repr" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "django_admin_log_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "django_admin_log_action_flag_check" CHECK ((action_flag >= 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."django_content_type" (
  "app_label" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "model" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "django_content_type_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."django_migrations" (
  "app" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "applied" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "django_migrations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."django_session" (
  "expire_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "session_data" text NOT NULL,
  "session_key" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "django_session_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("session_key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_aset" (
  "harga" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "kode_bmd_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "kode_lengkap" character varying(100),
  "kondisi" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "merk" character varying(255),
  "nama_barang" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "nomor_register" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_aset_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_cuti" (
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "dari_current" int4 NOT NULL,
  "dari_n" int4 NOT NULL,
  "dari_n1" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "jumlah_hari" int4 NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_mulai" date NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_selesai" date NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_cuti_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_cutisaldo" (
  "current" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "n" int4 NOT NULL,
  "n1" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_cutisaldo_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_kendaraan" (
  "foto" character varying(100),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "masa_pajak" date NOT NULL,
  "merk" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "no_mesin" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "no_rangka" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "plat_nomor" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "status_bayar" bool NOT NULL,
  "stnk" character varying(100),
  "tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_kendaraan_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_kgb" (
  "file_sk" character varying(100),
  "gaji_baru" int4 NOT NULL,
  "gaji_lama" int4 NOT NULL,
  "golongan" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kgb_berikutnya" date,
  "masa_bulan" int4 NOT NULL,
  "masa_tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  "no_sk" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "pangkat" character varying(100),
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_sk" date NOT NULL,
  "tmt_kgb" date NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_kgb_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_kodebmd" (
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kode" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "nama" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "parent_id" int8,
  CONSTRAINT "master_kodebmd_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_koderekening" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kategori" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "kode" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_koderekening_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_kp" (
  "file_sk" character varying(100),
  "gaji" int4 NOT NULL,
  "golongan" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis_kp" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "kp_berikutnya" date,
  "masa_bulan" int4 NOT NULL,
  "masa_tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  "no_bkn" character varying(100),
  "no_sk" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "pangkat" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_bkn" date,
  "tanggal_sk" date NOT NULL,
  "tmt_kp" date NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_kp_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_logwa" (
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "nomor" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "response" text,
  "status" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_event" date NOT NULL,
  "tipe" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_logwa_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_masterbarang" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nama_barang" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_masterbarang_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_pegawai" (
  "foto" character varying(100),
  "golongan" character varying(20),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jabatan" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "nama" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "nip" character varying(18) NOT NULL,
  "no_hp" character varying(15) NOT NULL,
  "pangkat" character varying(100),
  CONSTRAINT "master_pegawai_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_pemegangaset" (
  "aset_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "kondisi" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_pemegangaset_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_pemegangkendaraan" (
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kendaraan_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "kondisi" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "pegawai_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_pemegangkendaraan_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_servicebarang" (
  "aset_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "catatan" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "file" character varying(100),
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "keluhan" text NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "kode_barang" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "kondisi_akhir" text,
  "kondisi_awal" text,
  "nama_barang" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "no_service" character varying(100),
  "pegawai" character varying(200),
  "penerima" character varying(200),
  "penerima_service" character varying(200),
  "status" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_kembali" date,
  "tanggal_service" date NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_servicebarang_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_servicefile" (
  "file" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "service_id" int8 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_servicefile_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."master_transaksi" (
  "batch_id" character varying(50),
  "harga" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jumlah" int4 NOT NULL,
  "kode_rekening" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "nama_barang" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "sisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal" date NOT NULL,
  "tipe" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "total" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "master_transaksi_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
